import time
from svrptw.config import Settings
from svrptw.council.proposal import OperatorContext
from svrptw.io import Instance
from svrptw.solvers.common import Route, Solution, evaluate
import copy

def operator(solution: Solution, context: OperatorContext) -> Solution | None:
    inst: Instance = context.instance
    settings: Settings = context.settings
    deadline = time.perf_counter() + context.deadline_seconds
    routes = [r for r in solution.routes if r.customers]
    if len(routes) < 2:
        return None
    load_map = [(sum(inst.customers[c-1].demand for c in r.customers), i) for i, r in enumerate(solution.routes) if r.customers]
    load_map.sort()
    if len(load_map) < 2: return None
    idx1, idx2 = load_map[0][1], load_map[1][1]
    if sum(inst.customers[c-1].demand for c in solution.routes[idx1].customers) + sum(inst.customers[c-1].demand for c in solution.routes[idx2].customers) <= inst.vehicle_capacity:
        new_sol = copy.deepcopy(solution)
        new_sol.routes[idx1].customers.extend(new_sol.routes[idx2].customers)
        new_sol.routes[idx2].customers = []
        new_cost = evaluate(inst, new_sol, settings)
        if new_cost < solution.metrics["operational_cost"]:
            return new_sol
    return None

from svrptw.council.proposal import OperatorContext
def operator(solution: Solution, context: OperatorContext) -> Solution | None:
    inst = context.instance
    deadline = time.perf_counter() + context.deadline_seconds
    routes = [r for r in solution.routes if r.customers]
    if len(routes) < 2: return None
    routes.sort(key=lambda r: len(r.customers))
    small_route = routes[0]
    if len(small_route.customers) > 3: return None
    best_sol = None
    best_cost = solution.metrics['operational_cost']
    for target_idx, target_route in enumerate(solution.routes):
        if time.perf_counter() >= deadline: break
        if target_route is small_route: continue
        for i in range(len(target_route.customers) + 1):
            new_sol = Solution(routes=[r.copy() for r in solution.routes])
            new_sol.routes = [r for r in new_sol.routes if r.customers != small_route.customers]
            target = [r for r in new_sol.routes if r.customers == target_route.customers][0]
            target.customers[i:i] = small_route.customers
            if all(sum(inst.customers[c].demand for c in r.customers) <= inst.vehicle_capacity for r in new_sol.routes):
                cost = evaluate(inst, new_sol, context.settings)['operational_cost']
                if cost < best_cost:
                    best_cost = cost
                    best_sol = new_sol
    return best_sol

from __future__ import annotations
import time
import numpy as np
from svrptw.config import Settings
from svrptw.council.proposal import OperatorContext
from svrptw.io import Instance
from svrptw.solvers.common import Solution, evaluate, Route

def operator(solution: Solution, context: OperatorContext) -> Solution | None:
    inst = context.instance
    deadline = time.perf_counter() + context.deadline_seconds
    if len(solution.routes) < 2: return None
    densities = []
    for i, r in enumerate(solution.routes):
        if len(r.customers) < 2: continue
        coords = np.array([inst.customers[c-1].coords for c in r.customers])
        dist = np.mean(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(coords, axis=0), axis=1))
        densities.append((dist, i))
    if len(densities) < 2: return None
    densities.sort(reverse=True)
    idx1, idx2 = densities[0][1], densities[1][1]
    c1, c2 = list(solution.routes[idx1].customers), list(solution.routes[idx2].customers)
    all_c = c1 + c2
    new_sol = Solution([r for i, r in enumerate(solution.routes) if i not in (idx1, idx2)])
    for c in all_c:
        best_pos, best_cost = None, float('inf')
        for r in new_sol.routes:
            for i in range(len(r.customers) + 1):
                t = list(r.customers); t.insert(i, c)
                test_r = Route(t)
                cost = evaluate(inst, Solution(new_sol.routes[:new_sol.routes.index(r)] + [test_r] + new_sol.routes[new_sol.routes.index(r)+1:]), context.settings)
                if cost < best_cost: best_cost, best_pos = cost, (r, i)
        if best_pos: best_pos[0].customers.insert(best_pos[1], c)
        else: new_sol.routes.append(Route([c]))
    if evaluate(inst, new_sol, context.settings) < solution.metrics['operational_cost']:
        return new_sol
    return None

from __future__ import annotations
import time
from svrptw.config import Settings
from svrptw.council.proposal import OperatorContext
from svrptw.io import Instance
from svrptw.solvers.common import Route, Solution, evaluate

def operator(solution: Solution, context: OperatorContext) -> Solution | None:
    inst = context.instance
    best_cost = solution.metrics['operational_cost']
    routes = [r for r in solution.routes if len(r.customers) >= 2]
    if len(routes) < 2: return None
    def get_avg_dist(r):
        c = [inst.depot] + r.customers + [inst.depot]
        d = sum(inst.travel_dist[c[i]][c[i+1]] for i in range(len(c)-1))
        return d / len(r.customers)
    routes.sort(key=get_avg_dist, reverse=True)
    r1, r2 = routes[0], routes[1]
    all_cust = r1.customers + r2.customers
    new_seq = [all_cust[0]]
    remaining = all_cust[1:]
    while remaining:
        curr = new_seq[-1]
        best_next = min(remaining, key=lambda x: inst.travel_dist[curr][x])
        new_seq.append(best_next)
        remaining.remove(best_next)
    for i in range(1, len(new_seq)):
        candidate = Solution([Route(new_seq[:i]), Route(new_seq[i:])])
        cost = evaluate(inst, candidate, context.settings)
        if cost < best_cost:
            return candidate
    return None

from __future__ import annotations
import time
import copy
from svrptw.config import Settings
from svrptw.council.proposal import OperatorContext
from svrptw.io import Instance
from svrptw.solvers.common import Route, Solution, evaluate

def operator(solution: Solution, context: OperatorContext) -> Solution | None:
    inst: Instance = context.instance
    settings: Settings = context.settings
    deadline = time.perf_counter() + context.deadline_seconds
    cap = float(inst.vehicle_capacity)
    routes = [r for r in solution.routes if r.customers]
    if len(routes) < 2: return None
    utils = [(sum(inst.customers[c-1].demand for c in r.customers)/cap, i) for i, r in enumerate(solution.routes) if r.customers]
    target_idx = min(utils, key=lambda x: x[0])[1]
    if utils[0][0] > 0.4: return None
    customers_to_move = list(solution.routes[target_idx].customers)
    sol_copy = copy.deepcopy(solution)
    sol_copy.routes[target_idx].customers = []
    for cid in customers_to_move:
        best_pos = -1
        best_r = -1
        min_inc = float('inf')
        for ri, r in enumerate(sol_copy.routes):
            if ri == target_idx: continue
            for pos in range(len(r.customers) + 1):
                temp = list(r.customers)
                temp.insert(pos, cid)
                sol_copy.routes[ri].customers = temp
                try: c = evaluate(inst, sol_copy, settings)
                except: continue
                if c < min_inc: min_inc, best_r, best_pos = c, ri, pos
        if best_r == -1: return None
        sol_copy.routes[best_r].customers.insert(best_pos, cid)
    new_cost = evaluate(inst, sol_copy, settings)
    return sol_copy if new_cost < solution.metrics['operational_cost'] else None
